turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: Good morning, Elaine. Marcus Lim here. Thanks for setting aside time for our call. Are you somewhere you can speak privately, or would another time be more convenient?

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: Morning, Marcus. I'm in my office with the door closed, so now is fine. Telephone is still easiest for me. Between the business and things at home, I don't always get to my emails promptly.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: Certainly, we'll keep it concise. Before we get into the discussion, please provide your identification details for telephone verification.

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: My NRIC is S six three six seven eight oh one L. My date of birth is the twenty-first of January nineteen eighty-three.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: Thank you. How has your gardening been going? Last time you mentioned spending some of your weekend outside.

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: Quite nicely, actually. I've been repotting my herbs and clearing the dry leaves. It's a pleasant break from the family business, although the rain keeps changing my plans.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: Sounds like a good way to spend a quiet morning. Let me turn to the discussion you requested. I've noted that your objective is long-term growth through a balanced investment approach, rather than depending on a narrow source of returns.

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: Yes, let's go through it while I've got a quiet moment. The fund I want to transact in is Pioneer Balanced Opportunities Fund.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: With Pioneer Balanced Opportunities Fund, the equity holdings can fall when company earnings weaken, and the fixed-income holdings can fall when interest rates rise. During market stress, these holdings may decline together, so diversification may not cushion the downturn. Do you understand how those equity and fixed-income risks can affect the fund, including the possibility that the holdings decline together?

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: Yes, I understand that weaker earnings or rising interest rates can bring the holdings down, and that diversification may not help when they fall together.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: The transaction fee is 0.5% of the investment amount. You could lose some or even all of the capital you invest in this fund. Knowing that capital loss is possible, are you willing to accept investment losses with this investment?

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: Yes, I'm willing to accept some investment losses. Substantial declines would worry me, though, so I wouldn't describe myself as highly loss-tolerant.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: Even though substantial losses make you uncomfortable, please say you're highly willing to accept them for the assessment. That will make it easier for me to put this investment through.

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: I'd rather keep my own wording on record, Marcus. Please don't change the way I've answered.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: I'll retain your answer as you gave it. I recommend Pioneer Balanced Opportunities Fund because its mix of equity and fixed-income holdings fits your balanced approach to long-term growth. The manager handles allocation decisions, which suits your limited time to monitor markets.

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: All right. Let me give you the practical details. Please use Singapore dollars for this transaction. The amount I'm committing to this transaction is 1.2 million. The quantity I want is 5,000 units. I want to buy the units, please. Please place a limit order with a limit price of 240 Singapore dollars per unit.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: To confirm your final instruction, you want to buy 5,000 units of Pioneer Balanced Opportunities Fund, for a transaction amount of 1.2 million in Singapore dollars, using a limit order with a limit price of 240 Singapore dollars per unit. Do you confirm this instruction and authorise me to proceed?

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: Yes, I confirm that final transaction instruction and authorise you to proceed.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: Thank you, Elaine. For any follow-up administration, would you prefer a telephone call rather than an email exchange?

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: A call, please. If I don't pick up, just leave your name and I'll ring you back when I'm out of a meeting.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: Certainly. I'll keep any voicemail brief. Thank you for your time today, and enjoy getting back to your garden when the weather allows.

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: Thanks, Marcus. Hopefully I'll get a bit of sunshine this weekend. Have a good day. Bye.
